# REAP — Appendix B: Financial Model
**Board Report Appendix | Sport Waikato / The Living Lab**
**Prepared:** April 2026 | **Classification:** Confidential — Board Use Only

**Note on pricing:** The board report references a $14.99/month subscription. Following the board review process, the subscription price has been updated to **$13.00/month NZD** — a psychologically stronger price point that is on-brand for REAP (13 = unlucky), positioned below the mainstream fitness app price band, and retains headroom to increase to $15–$16 in Year 2. All projections in this appendix use $13.00.

---

## Revenue Architecture

REAP has three core revenue streams:

| Stream | Description | Year 1 readiness |
|--------|-------------|-----------------|
| **Subscriptions** | $13/month recurring per participant | Ready at launch |
| **Sponsorship** | Prize, group league, and title sponsorship | Available from Season 1 |
| **RST Commission** | $3 per confirmed RST-referred participant | Available from Season 1 |

Future revenue streams (Year 2+): corporate league fees, RST licensing, annual championship, research data partnerships.

## Section 1: Subscription Revenue Model

### Pricing and Transaction Economics

| Item | Value |

| Subscription price | $13.00 NZD/month |
| Stripe fee (2.9% + $0.30) | $0.68 per transaction |
| **Net revenue per subscriber per month** | **$12.32 NZD** |
| Annual net revenue per subscriber (12 months) | $147.84 |
| GST treatment | Confirm with accountant — projections below are pre-GST |

### Subscriber Growth Assumptions

Sport Waikato targets a November 1, 2026 Season 1 launch following an October celebrity soft launch. Participant numbers are modelled as average active subscribers across a 12-month period, accounting for churn (cancellations following elimination or between seasons) and new acquisitions at each season start.

**Churn assumptions:**
- ~25–30% of participants will cancel within 60 days of being eliminated (conservative assumption)
- ~15–20% of active subscribers cancel between seasons
- Re-enrolment from previous seasons adds new subscribers each season

| Scenario | Year 1 avg subscribers | Year 2 avg subscribers | Year 3 avg subscribers |
|----------|----------------------|----------------------|----------------------|
| Conservative | 150 | 280 | 450 |
| **Base Case** | **250** | **450** | **700** |
| Optimistic | 400 | 750 | 1,200 |

## Section 2: Sponsorship Revenue Model

### Sponsorship Types and Pricing

| Type | Description | Indicative value |
|------|-------------|-----------------|
| **Prize Sponsorship** | Sponsor names one or more of the 7 performance awards. Logo in prize notifications, Survival Board, end-of-season communications | $5,000–$20,000 per season |
| **Group League Sponsorship** | Named branded group league, group survival board, end-of-season group activity report | $5,000–$25,000 per season |
| **Season Title Sponsorship** | "REAP — Powered by [Sponsor]" across all season materials | $20,000–$50,000 per season |
| **Research Partnership** | Access to aggregated de-identified season data, Living Lab research co-branding | $10,000–$30,000 per year |

### Sponsorship Revenue Scenarios (Annual — 4 seasons)

| Scenario | Sponsorship mix | Annual sponsorship revenue |
|----------|----------------|--------------------------|
| Conservative | Prize sponsorship only (1 sponsor, 4 seasons × $5,000) | $20,000 |
| Base Case | Prize sponsor + 1 group league (4 seasons × $10,000) | $40,000 |
| Optimistic | Prize + 2 group leagues + research partnership | $75,000 |

**Note on Year 1:** Year 1 has only 2 seasons (November + December 2026). Sponsorship in Year 1 is likely to be at conservative levels — sponsors want to see Season 1 performance data before committing.

| | Conservative | Base Case | Optimistic |
|-|-------------|----------|----------|
| Year 1 sponsorship (2 seasons) | $5,000 | $10,000 | $20,000 |
| Year 2 sponsorship (4 seasons) | $20,000 | $40,000 | $75,000 |
| Year 3 sponsorship (4 seasons) | $25,000 | $50,000 | $100,000 |

## Section 3: RST Commission Model

**Structure:** Regional Sport Trusts who generate confirmed paid sign-ups via their unique referral links receive $3 per confirmed paying participant.

**Effect on Sport Waikato:** RST commissions reduce the net effective revenue per RST-referred participant. At $12.32 net subscription revenue, Sport Waikato retains $9.32 per RST-referred participant per month (vs $12.32 for direct acquisition).

**RST referral volume assumptions:**
- Year 1: ~10% of participants via RST referral
- Year 2: ~15%
- Year 3: ~20% (as RST distribution grows)

| | Conservative | Base Case | Optimistic |
|-|-------------|----------|----------|
| Year 1 RST commissions paid | $45 | $75 | $120 |
| Year 2 RST commissions paid | $126 | $203 | $338 |
| Year 3 RST commissions paid | $270 | $420 | $720 |

**Note:** RST commission costs are low in Year 1–2. At scale (1,000+ participants), with 20% RST-referred, the annual commission cost rises to ~$720/year — still a small cost for national distribution.

## Section 4: Prize Fund

The prize fund is a **Sport Waikato operational commitment**, not an app operating cost, and is funded entirely from Sport Waikato's general operational funds (not from subscription revenue). This separation is legally required under the Gambling Act compliance strategy.

| | Per season | Year 1 (2 seasons) | Year 2+ (4 seasons/yr) |
|-|-----------|-------------------|-----------------------|
| Prize draws | 7 | 14 | 28 |
| Prize per draw | $666 | $666 | $666 |
| **Prize fund commitment** | **$4,662** | **$9,324** | **$18,648** |

**Prize sponsorship offset:** Sport Waikato should pursue a commercial sponsor to offset the prize fund. At $15,000 in prize sponsorship revenue, the net prize fund cost to Sport Waikato reduces from $18,648 to $3,648 annually.

## Section 7: Break-Even Analysis

### App Operations Only (Before Prize Fund)

- Annual app operating costs: $12,160 (Year 1)
- Net revenue per subscriber per year: $12.32 × 12 = $147.84
- **Break-even subscribers: 82 average active subscribers**

At $13/month, 82 active subscribers cover all app operating costs. This is a very low break-even and is achievable in the first season.

### Including Prize Fund

- Total annual commitment (app + prizes): $21,484 (Year 1)
- **Break-even subscribers (Year 1, no sponsorship): 145 average active subscribers**
- **Break-even subscribers (Year 1, with $10k sponsorship): 76 average active subscribers**

Conservative Year 1 target of 150 subscribers comfortably exceeds break-even.

### Including Setup/Legal Costs

- Total Year 1 investment (app + prizes + setup): $34,784
- Break-even with $10k sponsorship: 168 average active subscribers
- **Fully self-funding at ~170 average subscribers in Year 1**

## Section 9: Sensitivity Analysis

### Impact of Sponsorship on Profitability

| Year 1 scenario | No sponsorship | $10k sponsorship | $20k sponsorship |
|-----------------|---------------|-----------------|-----------------|
| Conservative (150 subs) | -$7,653 | $2,347 | $12,347 |
| Base Case (250 subs) | $2,101 | $12,101 | $22,101 |
| Optimistic (400 subs) | $34,232 | $44,232 | $54,232 |

**Key insight:** At base case subscriber numbers, even without any sponsorship, Year 1 generates a small surplus. Sponsorship accelerates profitability significantly and largely offsets the prize fund cost.

### Price Sensitivity

| Price | Net/subscriber/month | Break-even (app only) | Break-even (incl. prizes) |
|-------|---------------------|----------------------|--------------------------|
| $11.00 | $10.01 | 101 | 178 |
| $13.00 | $12.32 | 82 | 145 |
| $15.00 | $14.64 | 69 | 122 |
| $17.00 | $16.96 | 60 | 105 |

At $13, break-even is comfortably achievable. There is headroom to increase to $15 in Year 2 if product-market fit is demonstrated, which would reduce the Year 2 break-even from ~145 to ~122 subscribers.

---

## Section 10: Assumptions and Limitations

| Assumption | Basis | Sensitivity |
|------------|-------|-------------|
| $13/month subscription | Board decision, April 2026 | Medium — could go to $15 Y2 |
| Stripe fees 2.9% + $0.30 | NZ standard rate | Low — unlikely to change materially |
| 150/250/400 avg subscribers Year 1 | No real-world data | HIGH — single most uncertain variable |
| $10k base case sponsorship Year 1 | Conservative estimate | Medium — depends on pitch success |
| 4 seasons/year from Year 2 | Operational assumption | Medium — may be 3–5 |
| $4,662 prize fund per season | 7 × $666, board-approved | Low — fixed by board resolution |
| Infrastructure costs $130/month | Current market rates | Low |
| Marketing $7,800 Year 1 | Includes launch push | Medium — may need adjustment |
| 10% RST referral Year 1 | Assumption — no RST distribution agreements yet | High — depends on RST engagement |

**Critical caveat:** All financial projections are based on no historical Season 1 data. No season has been run. Participant numbers, churn rates, re-enrolment rates, and sponsor conversion rates are all assumptions. Season 1 is the first real validation of these assumptions. The board is approving a well-reasoned financial model, not a validated business case.
